name: One Anomaly Detected
source:
Flint Callos is a mechanic assigned to spend the next six months on the CS Harmony, a ship owned by the renowned Fletcher Co. However, a murder onboard will throw everything he knows about his surroundings into chaos. And the people he's surrounded by. 

Make choices and identify anomalies onboard to keep you and the crew alive, or face the same fate as the creature's first victim.

[From [url=https://barbieronpa.itch.io/one-anomaly-detected]itch.io[/url]]
